title: Tech Note: [3rd Party Tech Note] SQL Lookups without Tears
author: David Adams

historical_commentary.text: 4D's embedded SQL (Begin SQL/End SQL) remains supported today, so this note's core technique — a validated, named-lookup wrapper around ad hoc SQL SELECT statements to avoid silent breakage from renamed/retyped fields — is still directly usable. That said, ORDA's entity/attribute-based queries, introduced from v16 R5/R6 onward, offer a more structurally safe alternative for many of the same lookup scenarios without needing hand-rolled validation tooling.
related_updates: 4D embedded SQL remains a supported feature
ORDA entity selections/attribute queries (v16 R5/R6, 2017+) provide a structurally validated alternative to raw SQL string lookups for many use cases
